chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Salamah from Ali ibn Saif ibn 'Amirah from Tufayl ibn Malik al-Nakha'i from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya from Safwan ibn Sulayman from his father from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) who said:
"Whoever visits me in my lifetime and after my death will be in my neighborhood/protection on the Day of Resurrection."
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the Prophet Muhammad after his death?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith underscores the enduring spiritual bond between the believer and the Prophet, affirming that *ziyarah* is not merely a physical act but a means of securing divine proximity (*jiwar*) on the Day of Judgment. It reflects the Shia emphasis on the continuity of the Prophet’s intercessory status and the merit of honoring his grave, linking earthly devotion to eternal reward.
